name: MegaUSD
oneLiner: USDM is MegaETH's dollar stablecoin issued on Ethena's USDtb rails, backed ~90% by BlackRock BUIDL tokenized Treasuries; reserve yield funds sequencer costs.
collateral: ~90% USDtb (BlackRock BUIDL tokenized Treasuries via Securitize) with liquid stablecoins for redemptions
pegMechanism: Issued on Ethena's USDtb rails; reserve yield funds MegaETH sequencer costs

genius.notes: Issuer is MegaUSD (BVI) Ltd, incorporated in the British Virgin Islands (confirmed via Terms of Service and Mint User Agreement at app.megausd.money). U.S. users are explicitly excluded from USDm Mint services. The coin's marketing references USDtb's 'line of sight to GENIUS Act compliance' via Anchorage Digital Bank, but this applies to USDtb (the underlying asset), not to MegaUSD (BVI) Ltd itself. No US bank charter, money-transmission license, PPSI application, or foreign-exception filing was found. GENIUS Act rulemaking remains at proposed-rules stage; no PPSI approvals exist anywhere as of 2026-06-07.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: MegaUSD (BVI) Ltd is incorporated in the British Virgin Islands; US users are explicitly excluded from Mint services. No US PPSI application, state qualification, OCC conditional approval, or foreign-exception filing was found for MegaUSD or its BVI issuer entity. The USDtb 'GENIUS line of sight' claim belongs to Anchorage Digital Bank (USDtb issuer), not to MegaUSD (BVI) Ltd.

mintAuthority.summary: USDM is MegaETH's dollar issued on Ethena's USDtb rails and backed ~90% by USDtb; its supply tracks USDtb-backed issuance, so it inherits USDtb's Ethena-operated mint authority rather than running an independent mint path.

controls.evidence: USDM is issued on Ethena's USDtb rails and reserve-backed ~90% by USDtb (plus liquid stablecoins for redemptions); its supply changes against USDtb-denominated backing rather than creating base USDtb supply.

controls.label: Inherited USDtb off-chain attested mint authority
controls.evidence: Underlying USDtb is minted via Ethena issuer/backend-mediated (signed order) rails with LayerZero OFT distribution. USDM inherits this concentrated-admin posture from the USDtb parent.

review.evidence: USDM (MegaUSD) is issued on Ethena's USDtb rails and backed ~90% by USDtb (reserves coinId usdtb-ethena, depType implicit wrapper). It inherits USDtb's offchain-attested mint path and concentrated-admin posture; no independent MegaETH mint authority was identified. inheritedFrom set to usdtb-ethena (coin has no variantOf field).
